decisions.reason: Report grounds the diagnosis in plugin-dock-chips.js: pinpoints the disabled: ... || busy expression in AttachmentChips, shows busy is AttachButton's useState local and unbound in the sibling's scope chain, explains the empty-dock early return null skips the line, and that an occurrence present in plain phase makes the left guard false so busy is evaluated, throwing ReferenceError.

Grounded in the fixture: explains the render-phase throw is caught by the slot error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry (not just the remove button), the separate input.left attach-button slot has its own boundary and survives, and the error is visible only in the browser console with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 file to show busy already exists in the baseline, proposes a rollback/re-add bisection with a data-present plain-phase jsdom mount, correctly flags that feature.diff has a stale base (re-adds || busy, omits the aria-label) and that imageItem is placed at function scope before the callback-scoped status/record, and explicitly declines to overclaim about which historical users first hit the failure.

Removes the dangling busy reference while preserving the phase guard (or scopes it to owned data like record status / lifted props), hardens arrays with (record?.items ?? []).find(...), guards DOM access with event.target.closest?.(...) plus an instanceof Element check, and moves imageItem inside the map callback where record/status are defined.

Proposes a jsdom render smoke mounting AttachmentDock with an occurrence in plain phase, asserting the chip and remove control render and the console spy sees no error-boundary capture; explains the empty state returns null before the throwing line and locked phases short-circuit past busy, and that node --check only parses and cannot resolve free identifiers or execute the component; includes the data-present slot smoke in the pre-ship gates.
